Q001.rationale: V=IR=3x13=39V correct; bare one-step plug-in with a single option (degenerate MCQ).

Q002.rationale: mean=7, MAD=12/5=2.4 correct; distractors (mean/range/sum) are genuine misconception traps.

Q003.rationale: v=2+12=14, KE=0.5x6x196=588J correct; distractor d uses initial velocity (real misconception).

Q004.rationale: Femur is appendicular, not axial; correct. Distractors are all true axial members (clean boundary test), but pure recall.

Q005.rationale: Increasing effective nuclear charge in same shell is the correct direct cause; distractors are period-vs-group confusions.

Q006.rationale: KE=200J correct, BUT options a and c are BOTH '200 J' - two identical correct keys makes the item defective/ambiguous.

Q007.rationale: Series R=4+6=10 correct; distractor 2.4 is the parallel result (targeted misconception).

Q008.rationale: A and R both true, R correctly explains A; sound A-R item though solution is terse.

Q009.rationale: n=96/48=2 mol correct; trivial one-step, single option (no real MCQ).

Q010.rationale: A true (metal R rises with T), R false (resistivity rises, not falls) -> 'A true, R false' correct; good directional trap.

Q011.rationale: 8/2=4 correct but far too trivial for a NEET label; distractors (3,5,6) are random near-numbers, not misconceptions.

Q012.rationale: Series R=3+9=12 correct; parallel trap 2.25 well chosen but this is a clear clone of the other series items.

Q013.rationale: Glucose reabsorbed in PCT correct; distractors are real nephron parts with distinct functions (structure-function discrimination).

Q014.rationale: F=ma=15x11=165N correct; trivial one-step, single option.

Q015.rationale: Both true, R explains A; correct but a near-duplicate of Q008.

Q016.rationale: Stomatal closure most directly cuts transpiration; correct. 'Well-watered plant losing turgor at midday' scenario is slightly contrived but answer is clear.

Q017.rationale: Chronic hypoxia -> erythropoietin -> increased RBCs correct; distractor b is a well-designed opposite-direction trap.

Q018.rationale: Zero resistance from absence of scattering; both true and R explains A. Superconductivity is a bit beyond a 'Foundation' tag.

Q019.rationale: mean=8, MAD=2.4 correct; but options b and c are BOTH '8' (mean and range coincide), so the distractor rationale is muddled and effective distractor count is reduced.

Q020.rationale: Mitochondrion is correct but this is a cliche rote-recall label far below NEET level; solution itself admits no misconception rationale.

Q021.rationale: Series R=10+15=25 correct; parallel trap 6.0 well chosen but third clone of the series template.

Q022.rationale: v=5+12=17, KE=0.5x2x289=289J correct; d=25 uses initial velocity. Sound but a clone of the KE template.

Q023.rationale: Definition of totipotency acceptable but narrowed to plants (general = whole organism from a single cell); open-ended 'define' recall shipped verbatim, no teaching value.
